request.raw_text: If edge with bigger radius is considered as top, add supporting structure to the bottom of the frame by offseting inner wall by 2cm with thickness of 0,5cm of the supporting structure all around. This will create step at the bottom of the frame, enlarging bottom surface area. Leave out radii at the bottom edges. Add radii from top, 0,2cm which will create smoothe transition from above. Bottom remains flat.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Existing circumferential edge having the larger edge radius
areas_to_change.location: Upper side of the rounded-rectangular frame
areas_to_change.description: Treat the side identified by the larger existing edge radius as the top; the opposite side is the bottom where the support is to be added.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Existing inner wall of the frame
areas_to_change.location: Around the complete inner perimeter at the bottom of the frame
areas_to_change.description: Create a continuous supporting ledge by offsetting the inner-wall boundary inward by 2 cm. Make the support 0.5 cm thick in the vertical direction, producing a wider annular bottom-bearing surface and a locally smaller opening at the bottom.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Upper edges of the newly added support where it transitions into the existing inner wall
areas_to_change.location: All around the top of the bottom support step
areas_to_change.description: Apply a 0.2 cm radius to the support's upper transition edges to blend the ledge smoothly into the wall above.

areas_to_change.action: Keep lower support edges unfilleted and planar
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Bottom face and bottom perimeter edges of the new support
areas_to_change.description: Do not add radii to the bottom edges. Keep the enlarged bottom face flat, with sharp lower step edges.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the outer footprint, straight side segments, corner geometry, and overall loop shape; the support should project inward rather than enlarge the exterior.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing upper portion of the frame
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing top geometry and the larger-radius edge used to identify the top, except where the new support's 0.2 cm upper blend joins the inner wall.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing central opening above the support
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep the current opening and inner-wall profile unchanged above the new 0.5 cm-thick bottom step.
Maintain one continuous closed rounded-rectangular frame without breaks, holes, or isolated support segments.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A rounded-rectangular frame with a continuous 2 cm inward-projecting, 0.5 cm-thick ledge around its bottom inner perimeter. The ledge has a flat underside and sharp bottom edges, while its upper edges have 0.2 cm radii blending into the inner wall.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The added ledge increases the frame's bottom contact and load-bearing area and provides continuous support around the opening.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The frame should sit on a broader flat bottom surface, while the filleted upper side of the ledge provides a smooth internal transition and the unfilleted underside maintains a flat, well-defined seating face.

ambiguities.description: The phrase 'offseting inner wall by 2cm' does not explicitly state the offset direction.
candidate_interpretations: Offset the inner-wall profile 2 cm inward into the opening, creating a 2 cm-wide supporting ledge; this best matches the stated enlargement of the bottom surface area.
Offset the inner wall 2 cm outward into the existing frame material, which would not clearly create the requested inward support and is therefore less likely.

ambiguities.description: The meaning of the specified 0.5 cm support thickness is not explicitly tied to an axis.
candidate_interpretations: Use 0.5 cm as the vertical thickness measured upward from the flat bottom face.
Use 0.5 cm as an in-plane wall thickness, although this conflicts with the separate 2 cm offset and the requested bottom step.

ambiguities.description: The phrase 'Add radii from top, 0,2cm' does not identify the exact edge set.
candidate_interpretations: Fillet all upper edges of the newly added support with a 0.2 cm radius, especially the transition to the inner wall.
Fillet both upper perimeter edges of the support, including any upper edge adjacent to the opening and any edge adjacent to the original wall.

ambiguities.description: The larger-radius edge used to define the top may refer either to an edge fillet through the frame thickness or to the rounded corners visible in plan.
candidate_interpretations: Use the side with the larger through-thickness edge fillet as the top, as suggested by the side and isometric views.
Use the plan-view corner radius as the orientation reference, although the corners appear substantially symmetric.
